name_reason: Name is fully compliant and accurate. Prefix data_fd2_ (game global) + battle_ (summon-spell is a battle subsystem, consistent with sibling symbols data_fd2_battle_summon_* in anisummn.c) + summon_spell_ domain + shared_ (genuinely shared by two functions, verified) + 15slot_ (array is exactly 15 int32 = 60 bytes, 0x53F42..0x53F7D, tight against next symbol data_fd2_battle_summon_spell_anim_phase_byte @ 0x53F7E; '15' is a real array dimension, NOT a Ghidra address residue) + frame_counter_array (reflects array type and per-slot frame-counter role). No address-residue suffix.
purpose: Per-slot frame/phase counter array for the summon-spell sprite orbit; single 15-element int array shared by two summon-spell dispatch-table handlers over disjoint slot windows.
logic_summary: int32[15] zero-bss runtime scratch (on-disk all 0x00). Two handlers share it without racing because each owns its own slot window and they run mutually exclusively: (1) fd2_tick_summon_spell_setup_pre_animation_8slot (0x26152, dispatch entry #0) uses slots 0..7 -- state_code 3 seeds frame_counter[i]=-2*i for i in 0..7, state 5 advances slots 0..6, blit gate 0<=x<0x10; (2) fd2_render_summon_aura_sprite_ring (0x262EF, dispatch entry #1, defined in src/gfx/rndscene.c) uses slots 7..14 via index [i+7] for i in 0..7 -- state_code 3 seeds frame_counter[i+7]=-2*i, state 5 advances+chimes those 8 slots, blit gate 0<=x<0xF. Slot 7 (0x53F5E) is the renderer's own init base (the shared seam). Treated signed: counters go negative while staggered slots ramp up; all access dword-wide and 4-byte strided. The 15-element size is required to cover slots 0..14 across both handlers.
element_semantics: Each element is a signed per-slot frame/phase counter for one sprite orbit slot. Seeded to a staggered negative value -2*i at INIT (state_code 3) and incremented each advance tick (state 5). Used as the sprite frame index in fd2_blit_indexed_sprite when 0 <= value < gate (0x10 for the setup handler's slots 0..6, 0xF for the renderer's slots 7..14); negative values mean the slot has not yet started.
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate but described only the setup handler's slots 0..7 in detail and mentioned the renderer merely as 'shared with', without explaining WHY the array is 15 elements (a reader could wrongly assume 8 slots suffice). The load-bearing fact -- the renderer uses slots 7..14 via [i+7], so the two disjoint windows together need 15 slots -- was missing.
notes: Verified 'shared' and '15slot' against ground truth via Ghidra: get_bulk_xrefs over all 15 slot addresses shows fd2_render_summon_aura_sprite_ring (0x262EF..0x26527) accessing slots 7..13 directly, and its decompile writes/reads data_fd2_battle_summon_spell_shared_15slot_frame_counter_array[iVar1+7] (slots 7..14) while fd2_tick_summon_spell_setup_pre_animation_8slot accesses [i] (slots 0..7). Array boundary confirmed: next symbol data_fd2_battle_summon_spell_anim_phase_byte @ 0x53F7E is exactly 60 bytes after base, so int32[15] is the correct tight dimension. Existing Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT already documents the disjoint slot windows and is consistent with the refined src comment, so plate left unchanged. is_const=false: array is written by both handlers at runtime (init stores + per-tick increments).
